title: Atlas Construction Operation v1
description: Typed decode target for one ACP (Atlas Construction Protocol) wire operation, per .atlas/contracts/ASIR-CONSTRUCTION-MODEL.md. A provider's JSON/tool-call payload MUST decode into this shape before any downstream validation stage inspects it; provider-transport-specific framing MUST NOT survive past this decode. This is a proposal envelope, never canonical state by itself -- admission into canonical ASIR is governed by EXTERNAL-PROVIDER-TRUST.md's authority model.

op_id.description: Stable identity of this proposed operation within its owning transaction. Not a canonical SemanticRecordId -- that identity is assigned only on admission.

dialect.description: Dialect namespace, e.g. 'atlas.cf', 'atlas.state', 'atlas.effect'. See ASIR-CONSTRUCTION-MODEL.md's reserved namespace list.

opcode.description: Opcode within the dialect, e.g. 'cond_branch', 'read', 'require'. The full dialect-qualified name is '<dialect>.<opcode>'.

attributes.description: Typed, schema-validated key/value data. Never a channel for unvalidated free-form content to bypass this schema's own required fields.

effects.description: Every effect this operation may produce, dialect-qualified (e.g. 'atlas.effect.panic'). Every effectful operation MUST declare its effects here -- never discovered only by executing it.

required_capabilities.description: Explicit capability/authority references this operation requires. Every privileged effect MUST bind to an explicit entry here, never an implicit ambient permission.

evidence_refs.description: Must resolve to real evidence (e.g. a ProviderReceipt or extraction evidence record). An operation with no evidence chain is not admissible.

provider_receipt_ref.description: Which ProviderReceipt produced this proposed operation. Required -- an operation with no attributable provider invocation cannot be admitted.

status.description: Mirrors the admission pipeline stages in ASIR-CONSTRUCTION-MODEL.md. Only ADMITTED operations may contribute to canonical ASIR state.
